title: Warehouse Modernization Discovery
notes: Derived from fixtures/warehouse_modernization.json authored artifacts+evidence. Evidence turn_index is 0-based into transcript.turns; quote is verbatim.

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Improve warehouse flow and prevent avoidable truck-loading delays.

evidence.quote: find out about delays after a truck is already waiting

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Warehouse supervisors need timely visibility into order status throughout picking.

evidence.quote: do not have a reliable real-time view of where orders are in the picking process

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The solution shall refresh order-status information within 30 seconds of a source-system state change.
The solution shall operate on the rugged tablets currently issued to floor leads.

evidence.quote: rugged tablets the floor leads already carry

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The solution shall integrate with the existing WMS without requiring replacement this fiscal year.

evidence.quote: cannot replace the warehouse management system this year

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Available WMS interfaces may not support a 30-second end-to-end refresh target.
Which order states, exceptions, and alerts must supervisors see?
Which functions must remain available during degraded connectivity, and for how long?
The solution shall be delivered and live before the end of Q3, ahead of peak season.

evidence.quote: go-live by the end of Q3

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The solution shall restrict pick reassignment to shift supervisors; floor staff have read-only status access.

evidence.quote: Only shift supervisors should be able to reassign picks

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The solution shall continue core status functions during connectivity loss and reconcile data on reconnection.

evidence.quote: keep working when the Wi-Fi drops in the yard
